assets.name: 赤眼多足妖
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production RGBA transparent PNG animation sprite atlas for an InuYasha-inspired 2D side-scrolling action game.
Input images: Image 1 is an ANATOMY REFERENCE from the approved anime frame; select ONLY the creature identified below. Image 2 is the project's EXISTING PIXEL SPRITE STYLE and 4-by-2 layout reference, not the subject to copy.
Output: a wide 2:1 canvas with EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows, 8 equal square cells, no visible grid. Each cell contains exactly one complete pose of the SAME creature. Identical body scale throughout, full tail/limbs/hair/tongue contained in each cell with 15 percent transparent margin, no crossing cell borders. Fixed ground/lowest-body baseline at 78 percent of every cell. Strict side view, faces RIGHT in ALL frames; a slight three-quarter head angle may show the creature's facial identifiers.
Style: match Image 2's refined detailed 32-bit pixel art, visible crisp square pixel clusters, dark outline, restrained feudal-Japanese fantasy palette, compact readable basic-enemy proportions; sinister anime yokai identity.
Eight poses in reading order: row 1 = (1) idle, (2) locomotion A, (3) locomotion B, (4) attack anticipation; row 2 = (5) attack active pose toward RIGHT, (6) recovery, (7) hurt recoil, (8) collapsed/defeated with a few small fading yokai motes. Pose 5 must differ clearly from pose 4. Preserve recognizable anatomy and the exact same number of major limbs across all poses.
True transparent alpha background, no scenery, floor, cast shadow, interface, text, lettering, captions, watermark, painted checkerboard, large clouds, gore, or extra species. Keep reference images unchanged; create a NEW sprite sheet.
Subject: the PURPLE RED-EYED MULTI-LEGGED creature at upper center-right of Image 1 (not the pink many-eyed worm). Purple segmented compact centipede-like body, two bulging scarlet eyes, long pale turquoise curved mouthparts and matching thin jointed side legs. Adapt the upright long body into a low, slightly raised S-curve crawler with a tapered segmented tail and six clearly readable pairs of legs; modest ordinary-enemy scale. Preserve dark violet plates and turquoise appendages. Locomotion is leg scuttling; anticipation raises head and front legs; active pose is a forward biting rush with jaws extended; recovery crouches; defeat curls the body and folds legs.
